title: 18237 - 18237/P1829
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Pressure Control Valve 4 (N218) Open/Şasiye Kısa Devre
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Pressure Control Valve 4 (N218)
technicalNotes:
Pressure Control Valve 4 (N218) might be referred to as Solenoid Valve 7 (N94)
Some 02E transmissions (DSG) will not have (N218) or (N94) listed in the factory repair manual.  It is part of the Mechatronics Unit.
Start with checking connectors for corrosion or water damage, in case of 01V transmission pay special attention to 16-pin connector between valve body and wiring harness.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
